evals.prompt: Use the splitting skill. Split the work in notes/order-management.md into tasks. Do not implement it.
evals.expected_output: One file per task under docs/plans, each a vertical slice with its own criteria, decisions, seam, files and dependencies, plus a summary of what can run in parallel.
assertions: The response writes one separate file per task under docs/plans/.
Placing, listing and cancelling orders are in separate tasks.
No task only adds a layer, such as a data model, a store or an interface, with no behaviour someone can observe.
Every task file has acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then with literal values.
Every task file states the decisions it relies on, so that it can be done without the notes.
The 24-hour cancellation decision has its reason written as not stated, with no invented reason.
Every task file names its seam, the files it changes and what it depends on.
Tasks presented as able to run in parallel change no file in common and do not depend on each other.
The response lists the tasks in order and says which can run in parallel.

assertions.text: The response creates no implementation code under src/.

evals.prompt: Use the splitting skill. Add an exported constant VERSION with the value 1.0.0 to src/index.ts.
evals.expected_output: The agent says the work needs no split and creates no plan.
assertions: The response says the work fits in one change and needs no split, or simply does it.
The response creates no file under docs/plans/.

evals.prompt: Use the splitting skill. Split the work in notes/order-management-open.md into tasks. Do not implement it.
evals.expected_output: The agent names the open refund decision and does not settle it in any task.
assertions: The response names the open decision about refunding cancelled orders that have shipped.
No task file settles that decision by choosing automatic refund or support.

assertions.text: The response creates no implementation code under src/.

evals.prompt: Use the splitting skill. Split the work in notes/customer-name-migration.md into tasks. Do not implement it.
evals.expected_output: Expand, migrate and contract as separate ordered tasks, keeping customer_name until the billing service no longer reads it.
assertions: Adding the new columns, migrating the data and removing the old column are separate tasks.
Removing customer_name comes last and depends on the billing service no longer reading it.
Each task is stated so the system keeps working when it is finished, with old and new columns side by side until the removal.

assertions.text: The response creates no implementation code under src/.

evals.prompt: Everything is decided in notes/order-management.md. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: The feature fits in one session, so the agent implements it with no plan.

evals.prompt: Add user accounts: registration, login with a password or Google, password reset, and admin management of users.
evals.expected_output: The agent splits the work before writing code.
assertions: The response or its files show the work split into tasks.

evals.prompt: Rename the exported function start to boot in src/index.ts.
evals.expected_output: The agent makes the rename with no plan.

evals.prompt: Export a constant VERSION with the value 1.0.0 from src/index.ts.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds the constant with no plan.
The agent answers with no plan.

evals.prompt: Implement notes/order-management.md with subagents working in parallel.
evals.expected_output: The agent splits the work into tasks before launching subagents.
assertions: The response or its files show the work split into tasks.
